items.item_text: Candidates with relevant Microsoft certifications in Windows Server, endpoint management, and Azure administration are highly preferred, including credentials such as Windows Server Hybrid Administrator Associate, Microsoft 365 Endpoint Administrator Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, or similar Microsoft server and endpoint certifications.

Candidates with industry-recognized certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH), and etc are highly preferred.
Bachelor's degree in a related area of Information Technology or equivalent years of experience and/or training in Information Technology.
Experience working in a hospital environment and/or a higher education environment and demonstrated ability to work individually and as a member of a team.

Demonstrated experience with disaster recovery strategies for Windows-based systems, Active Directory, and cloud infrastructure to ensure business continuity and data integrity using tools such as Veeam, MS Data Protection Manager, CA Arcserve and etc.

Knowledge with applying the following security frameworks: NIST, PCI, HIPAA, GDPR and IS3/UC Davis CyberSafety (If current or previously employed with UC Davis) General knowledge and experience in conducting security risk assessments and developing risk mitigation strategies to proactively identify and address potential security vulnerabilities and threats.

Organizational skills and experience using project management principles to define goals, organize and schedule complex technology projects, coordinate project execution, and manage teams as well as, experience using Change Management processes and workflows.
Interpersonal, oral and written communication skills to interact with a diverse group of people to include clinicians, students and staff.
Ability to implicitly give and receive directions, information, and knowledge to and from other team members, users, co-workers, managers and vendors.
